Thanks for the clear summary. We can support the staggered cutover you described. High-level options (we'll follow with a formal SOW & amendment):

Option A — Minimal-term, fast-provision
- Provision 4 on-prem nodes as add-on (prorated for remainder of current term)
- Lead time: ~6 business days to provision and validate networking with your ops team
- No term change; standard add-on pricing applies

Option B — Term-commit discount (recommended)
- Commit to a 24-month extension at renewal across the Private environment
- We apply a 12% list discount on committed node capacity + $0.02/token unit rebate for steady-state usage
- We will seed 2 nodes now (prorated) and schedule remaining 2 on the effective renewal date to avoid reconfig windows

I'll attach a draft SOW and a capacity workbook with ballpark numbers. Monica and Karthik — can you review the pricing back-of-envelope and confirm if Legal needs an amendment or a simple addendum?

1) We share a priced SOW (today)
2) MedEx confirms preferred option and signs amendment/DocuSign
3) Engineering spaces a kickoff & net testing window

If you prefer, we can hop on a 30-min call Monday to walk through options.
